components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF9430; color: #0C0C0E; font-family: 'Exo 2', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF9430; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.95); }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Show-on-overlay and settings switches. Orange means on.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-toggle-track { width: 36px; height: 20px; border-radius: 10px; background: #2A2A2E; position: relative; display: block; } .ds-toggle-track::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; transition: left 0.12s ease; } .ds-toggle input:checked + .ds-toggle-track { background: #FF9430; } .ds-toggle input:checked + .ds-toggle-track::after { left: 19px; } .ds-toggle input:focus-visible + .ds-toggle-track { outline: 2px solid #FF9430; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bike Pill
components.description: Manufacturer-colored badge. Ink flips for contrast; never follows table text color.
components.html: KTMYZCRF

components.name: Skew Plaque

narrative.overview:
Holeshot HUD is a TV race overlay sitting on the game: dark plaques, skewed hardware bars, and a hot orange that always means *you*. It is broadcast-hot — stronger bars, louder flags, denser tables — not a quiet utility panel and not a consumer app shell. The rider glances; the graphic has to punch.

Type is Exo 2 ExtraBold Italic at table scale. Corners stay modest. Chrome is opt-in: a fresh install draws nothing. The website is the same HUD on a charcoal stage, not a second identity. Settings is the same family in opaque charcoal.

Do not drift toward generic sim-HUD blues, glassmorphism blobs, or light “esports dashboard” kits. Manufacturer bike colors stay on pills only.
keyCharacteristics: Dark plaques over the game; orange is you / CTA only
Skewed TV bars and bike-brand pills as hardware, not cards
Exo 2 ExtraBold Italic as the HUD face (Teko / Goldman optional)
Tonal charcoal stacking for depth — almost no drop shadows
Race meaning uses blue / red / green / violet, never a second orange

rules.name: The You-Are-Orange Rule
rules.body: Holeshot Orange is you, CTA, and accent. Other riders are Field Slate unless lapping/closing paints them blue or red.

rules.name: The Meaning-Not-Brand Rule
rules.body: Blue, red, green, and violet carry race state. They are never decorative theme colors.

rules.name: The One-Face Rule
rules.body: HUD and settings speak Exo 2 (or the rider’s Teko / Goldman). Segoe is web-shell only.

rules.name: The Italic Default Rule
rules.body: The bundled Exo 2 cut is italic extra-bold. Do not “correct” it to a roman UI font.

rules.name: The Opt-In Chrome Rule
rules.body: Nothing draws until Show on overlay is on. Empty race data shows “Waiting for race data”, not a blank plaque.

rules.name: The Tonal Stack Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. No ambient card shadows. A knob may sit on a small dark disc; a standings board may not.

rules.name: The TV Plaque Rule
rules.body: Skewed bars and manufacturer pills are broadcast hardware. Do not replace them with cards, chips-in-a-row, or Material buttons.

dos: Do keep Holeshot Orange for you, CTA, and accent only.
Do use Exo 2 ExtraBold Italic as the default HUD face.
Do ship bike pills in manufacturer colors with contrast-flipped ink.
Do start every widget hidden on a fresh install.
Do treat map fill as transparent unless the rider raises opacity.
donts: Don't invent a second lapping palette for minimap or radar.
Don't bring back radar side/rear zone wedges.
Don't add drop shadows under HUD tables.
Don't let Segoe / web-shell type into overlay widgets.
Don't recode manufacturer pills to follow White/Black table text.
Don't draw overlay work into the in-game C++ HUD (ingame_hud).
